title: Muskogean Tribes Musical Influence on the Genre of Delta Blues
text: The Shell Shaker’s pattern in Muskogean music follows a doublebeat pattern of eighth notes, much like our hearts. This rhythmic feel is also very present in Delta Blues songs.
